claims: The 2026 NCAA Division I Men's Ice Hockey Championship (Frozen Four) will take place at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas.
Semifinals of the 2026 NCAA Division I Men's Ice Hockey Championship will be on April 9, 2026.
The final of the 2026 NCAA Division I Men's Ice Hockey Championship will be on April 11, 2026.
The 2026 NCAA Division I Men's Ice Hockey Championship is a 16-team tournament.
The 2026 NCAA Division I Men's Ice Hockey Championship is a single-elimination tournament.
The 2026 NCAA Division I Men's Ice Hockey Championship features regional games leading to the Frozen Four.
Key teams in the 2026 NCAA Division I Men's Ice Hockey Championship included Michigan, Minnesota Duluth, Wisconsin, Michigan State, Denver, Cornell, Western Michigan, and North Dakota.
Western Michigan defeated Boston University 6-2 to win their first NCAA championship in 2025.
Denver leads with 10 all-time national championships.
Games of the 2026 NCAA Division I Men's Ice Hockey Championship are available on ESPN networks.
Games of the 2026 NCAA Division I Men's Ice Hockey Championship are available on the ESPN App.
